title: VocalAffectBench: Evaluating Vocal Emotion Recognition in AI Audio Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.28932v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Voice products increasingly need affective cues that are present in speech but absent from transcripts. We introduce VocalAffectBench, a public, test-only benchmark for evaluating whether AI audio models can identify expressed vocal emotion from raw audio. The benchmark contains 273 human-recorded English WAV clips from 51 speaker accounts totaling 1.95 hours across seven labels: angry, disgusted, fearful, happy, neutral, sad, and surprised, with 39 clips per class. All baselines are evaluated from audio alone, without transcripts or contextual metadata. Across six released baselines, average accuracy is 35.5%. The strongest baseline, gemini_3_5_flash, reaches 46.5% on the seven-way task, above the 14.3% random baseline but far from robust emotion recognition. translated_title: VocalAffectBench：评估AI音频模型中的语音情感识别能力
translated_abstract: 语音产品日益需要那些存在于语音中但转录文本里缺失的情感线索。我们推出了VocalAffectBench，这是一个公开的、仅用于测试的基准，用于评估AI音频模型能否从原始音频中识别出所表达的语音情感。该基准包含273段人工录制的英文WAV音频片段，来自51个说话人账户，总计1.95小时，涵盖七个情感标签：愤怒、厌恶、恐惧、快乐、中性、悲伤和惊讶，每个类别39个片段。所有基线模型仅基于音频进行评估，不使用转录文本或上下文元数据。在六个已发布的基线模型中，平均准确率为35.5%。表现最强的基线模型gemini_3_5_flash在七分类任务上达到46.5%，高于14.3%的随机基线水平，但距离稳健的情感识别仍有很大差距。一项辅助性的效价分桶分析将标签映射为积极、中性和消极三类，并排除了效价模糊的“惊讶”类别。在该合并分析下的总体准确率……（摘要截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了VocalAffectBench——一个包含273段人工录制音频、仅用于测试的公开基准，用于评估AI音频模型从原始音频中识别语音情感的能力，结果显示现有最强模型准确率仅46.5%，表明当前AI音频模型的情感识别能力远未达到稳健水平。
en_tdlr: VocalAffectBench, a public test-only benchmark of 273 human-recorded English audio clips across seven emotion labels, reveals that AI audio models perform poorly at vocal emotion recognition from raw audio, with the strongest baseline reaching only 46.5% accuracy on the seven-way task.
